title: Catastrophic-Share Credit Against Household Income — Hospital Account (Encounter Billing)
content:
On a Hospital Account (Encounter Billing) account whose coverage-terminated liability is discounted, the catastrophic share compares the coverage-loss amount (the total of the account's coverage-terminated liability postings) with the patient's household income as the Financial Assistance Program (Charity Care) documented it.

**Which income.** The annual household income documented on the patient's most recent assistance determination, when that determination is a denial. Determinations are read only among cases in approved, denied, expired or revoked status; an award, expiry or revocation dated the same day as a denial is taken as the later; of two same-day denials the first recorded is taken. The denial's age does not matter.

**Starting percent.** The starting coverage-loss discount percent is the patient class's elective uninsured discount percent for an account classified elective non-covered, and its uninsured discount percent for any other account.

**Clause.** When the coverage-loss amount is at least 20 percent of that income, a dollar credit is added equal to the coverage-loss amount times one minus the starting coverage-loss discount percent, less 20 percent of that income, rounded half-up to the cent and never below 250.00 USD. When it is at least 10 percent but below 20 percent of that income, a flat 250.00 is added. With no such denial, an income of 0.00, or a smaller share, nothing is added.

## Worked figures (hypothetical inputs)

| Income on the denial | Coverage-loss amount | Starting percent | Share of income | Credit added |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| 20000.00 | 10000.00 | 45 | 50 percent | 10000.00 times 0.55 is 5500.00, less 4000.00: 1500.00 |
| 40000.00 | 9000.00 | 50 | 22.5 percent | 4500.00 less 8000.00 is below 250.00: 250.00 |
| 50000.00 | 6000.00 | 50 | 12 percent | 250.00 flat |
| 50000.00 | 4000.00 | 50 | 8 percent | nothing |
| none (most recent determination an approval) | 10000.00 | 45 | not read | nothing |
